findings.quote: rule("L2 one cycle", len(admitted_cycles) <= 1, f"{admitted_cycles}; unadmitted: {unadmitted}")
findings.summary: With every active Issue un-cycled, admitted_cycles is empty and L2 PASSes (base FAILed with {None}); no fixture covers the zero-admitted case.
findings.failure_scenario: A project where nothing was admitted to a cycle clears L2 silently; the only signal is the free-text 'unadmitted: N' inside a PASS line.

findings.summary: An Issue with no state/type is treated as active; the live fetch always requests state{type}, so only a malformed offline snapshot reaches this, and it fails closed (spurious L9 FAIL) with no diagnostic naming the missing field.
findings.failure_scenario: A trimmed snapshot missing 'state' produces FAIL L9 misattributed to a by-product; untested.

findings.summary: Neither new fixture exercises the branch where every active Issue lacks a cycle, which now PASSes instead of failing as before.
findings.failure_scenario: All-Backlog project → PASS L2 'set(); unadmitted: N'; verified by clearing DEV-903's cycle in the dev122-done-pair fixture.

findings.summary: The retained dev89 assertion is vacuous: all three Issues are completed, l9_order is empty, so PASS L9 is trivial; dev122-started-pair is the only assertion exercising a real FAIL L9.
findings.failure_scenario: A regression breaking L9's comparison still prints PASS L9 on the dev89 fixture.
